user_intent: A single wide-angle editorial photo of a modern Kay-Twelve learning space showing all three RSC zones — high-energy collaboration (left), transition (center), low-energy focus (right). Racially diverse students. Bold saturated furniture: yellow tables, lime green stools, cobalt blue mobile chair, teal lounge seating. Authentic, candid feel — not a staged stock photo.

subject.description: Hispanic elementary school girl with medium brown skin, dark brown eyes, standing at a tall collaborative table with a bright yellow laminate top, laughing and pointing at a project spread across the surface. Candid, natural moment — not posed.
subject.pose: standing, leaning forward over bright yellow table, one hand pointing animatedly at project

subject.description: Black elementary school boy with dark brown skin, natural short hair, standing at the same bright yellow table writing on it with a marker, focused and engaged. Candid moment.
subject.pose: standing at tall yellow table, holding marker, writing directly on the white writeable table surface, slightly hunched forward

subject.description: White elementary school boy with light skin, reddish-brown hair, walking confidently through the open center of the room pushing a cobalt blue chair on casters. Mid-stride, relaxed.
subject.pose: mid-stride walking, both hands gripping the back of a cobalt blue chair on casters, rolling it across the open floor

subject.description: Asian elementary school girl with light tan skin, straight black hair worn loose, seated deeply in a large teal upholstered bean bag lounge chair, reading a picture book. Absorbed, relaxed posture.
subject.pose: sunk deep into large teal lounge chair, legs slightly curled, holding an open picture book, eyes cast down reading

subject.description: Black elementary school girl with dark brown skin, long box braids, seated cross-legged on a large lime green floor cushion near a bookshelf, writing in a composition notebook. Focused, natural.
subject.pose: seated cross-legged on lime green floor cushion, notebook open on lap, pencil in hand, writing

scene.location: Modern open-plan elementary school learning environment, three clearly distinct zones in one wide frame. LEFT HIGH-ENERGY ZONE: two tall standing-height collaborative tables with BRIGHT YELLOW writeable laminate tops on white metal frames, surrounded by LIME GREEN upholstered tall bar stools; a large whiteboard wall panel with authentic student drawings, diagrams, and handwriting in marker. CENTER TRANSITION ZONE: wide open polished concrete corridor, a COBALT BLUE lightweight mobile chair on casters being pushed across the floor. RIGHT LOW-ENERGY ZONE: a large TEAL bean bag lounge chair, LIME GREEN oversized floor cushions, a low natural wood open bookshelf stocked with colorful children's books. Walls are white with thin, narrow, architectural accent stripe lines in teal and yellow near the ceiling — subtle and designed, NOT a thick rainbow band, just two or three thin elegant horizontal accent lines like an architectural detail. Large windows along the right wall. Polished concrete floors throughout. The overall palette is bold and vibrant — teal, lime green, cobalt blue, yellow — not grey, not beige, not neutral.
